hooks.command: bash -c 'MODE=$(cat .claude/session_mode.txt 2>/dev/null || echo implementation); S=$(cat .claude/current_session.txt 2>/dev/null || echo unknown); if echo "$S" | grep -qi merge; then echo "Merge session — assessment not required"; else if [ ! -f "docs/assessments/session-${S}-assessment.md" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: Assessment file missing for session ${S} (create before ending)" >&2; exit 2; fi; if [ ! -f "docs/session_logs/session-${S}-log.md" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: Session log missing: docs/session_logs/session-${S}-log.md (create before ending)" >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; if [ "$MODE" = "interactive" ]; then DIRTY=$(git status --porcelain -- ":!.claude/commits_since_clear.txt" ":!.claude/session_mode.txt"); else DIRTY=$(git status --porcelain); fi; if [ -n "$DIRTY" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: Uncommitted files (commit before ending session)" >&2; echo "$DIRTY" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'set -o pipefail; INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"tool_input\",{}).get(\"command\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "\bgit commit\b"; then if [ -f .claude/parallel_session_active ]; then BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current); if [ "$BRANCH" = "main" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: Cannot commit to main during parallel session." >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo "."); if ! bash "$REPO/scripts/test-gate.sh" fast 2>&1 | tail -20; then echo "BLOCKED: Tests failed. Fix before committing." >&2; exit 2; fi; fi'

bash -c 'MODE=$(cat .claude/session_mode.txt 2>/dev/null || echo implementation); if [ "$MODE" = "interactive" ]; then exit 0; fi; COUNTER_FILE=".claude/commits_since_clear.txt"; CURRENT=$(cat "$COUNTER_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$CURRENT" -gt 0 ]; then echo "BLOCKED: $CURRENT commit(s) since last /clear. You must /clear before starting new work." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0'
bash -c 'S=$(cat .claude/current_session.txt 2>/dev/null || echo "?"); osascript -e "display notification \"Session ${S}: Awaiting input\" with title \"Claude Code\"" 2>/dev/null; exit 0'
